text:
elena: Heads up — we're ready to push release v2.14.0 to prod but the deploy bot is rejecting the job due to role/MFA. Can someone with prod-deploy rights help? Build: 2.14.0, commit: 7f3a9b2. Need canary in us-west first.

deploy-bot: @elena deploy-request received for job `release/v2.14.0` by nate. Status: BLOCKED. Reason: MFA check failed (user lacks `prod-deploy` role). Error log: `403 MFA_REQUIRED role=prod-deploy`. See https://internal.redwood/ops/deploy-bot/docs :robot_face:

jay: @maya can you grant nate temporary prod-deploy for this push? we only need canary (10%) then hold for 10m. :eyes:

maya: please don't just hand out permanent roles. use JIT access via Okta short-lived role or the privileged access request flow. https://okta.company/requests/new — set expiration 30m, audit enabled. Also need justification in the ticket.

elena: understood. nate — can you create the access request and ping back when it's approved? we want the canary started by 11:30 PT.

nate: creating request now. command I ran for auditors: `okta-cli grant --user nate --role prod-deploy --ttl 30m --reason "prod canary v2.14.0"` — pinging @maya.

maya: approved the request, set expire=30m and tagged with incident=none. audit id: AUD-20260318-4421. Remember to run with `--mfa` flag.

deploy-bot: Access change detected for user nate. MFA proof: present. Role assignment: prod-deploy (expires in 00:30:00). Re-evaluating queued job `release/v2.14.0`.

ops-sre: quick note — we pinned the runtime to model-server v1.9.3 in the manifest to avoid the new dispatcher changes; rollback plan is at docs/rollbacks/v2.14.0.md and includes `kubectl rollout undo` steps. Keep an eye on DB write latency during canary.

elena: starting canary now. running command: `./scripts/deploy --env prod --canary 10% --tag 7f3a9b2` — deploy-bot take it away. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: 10% traffic to release v2.14.0 (tag 7f3a9b2). Canary window 10m. Monitoring: latency, 5xx rate, error budget. Alerts: eng-sre oncall.

jay: attaching release notes snippet for when we go full: "Fixes N+1 on embedding endpoint, perf improvements for batching, quantization defaults adjusted." Will send the full changelog to product.

ops-sre: canary metrics at +5m: p95 latency +1.2ms, 5xx rate 0.01% (within baseline). No regressions in mem or cpu.

nate: confirmed deploy-bot acknowledged my MFA and role. thanks @maya.

maya: good. reminder: rotate the temporary creds if you need longer access — security policy prohibits extensions without approval.

elena: canary looks clean, proceeding with 50% then full after another check. Anyone object? :thumbsup:

jay: +1

maya: +1 (audit note added) :lock:

deploy-bot: Rolling to 50% now.

ops-sre: 50% stable at +8m. preparing to shift to 100% in 5m.

elena: full rollout initiated. deploy-bot, confirm when finished and include the final artifact info.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: release v2.14.0 deployed to prod (tag 7f3a9b2). Duration: 12m. Audit: AUD-20260318-4421. If issues observed: run `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/model-server --to-revision=3` and open #incidents. :white_check_mark:

jay: thanks everyone. Nate — you can self-revoke the JIT role or it will auto-expire.

nate: I'll revoke now: `okta-cli revoke --user nate --role prod-deploy` — done.

maya: verified revocation. logs show no lingering sessions. closing access ticket.

elena: closing thread — release notes pushed, changelog PR merged, post-release smoke tests green. good job team. :tada:
